composers_checked.name: Krenek, Ernst
composers_checked.note: All 3 IMSLP pages kept. Gap check against the en and de Wikipedia lists and MusicBrainz added the quartets Nos. 2, 4 and 6 (Sonare-Quartett, MDG), Nos. 5, 7 and 8, the Serenade Op. 4, the three string trios and the two trios with piano, each on a commercial recording. Not added: the Alpbach Quintet Op. 180 (a wind quintet), the wind and solo works, the Hausmusik Op. 172 pieces (easy house music).

composers_checked.name: Weill, Kurt
composers_checked.note: Op. 8 kept; gap check added the B-minor quartet of 1918 and the song cycle Frauentanz (voice with five instruments, recorded by BR Klassik; its IMSLP page was not in the input). The violin concerto, Der neue Orpheus, Quodlibet and Kleine Dreigroschenmusik are for orchestra or wind band, the cello sonata is a duo.

composers_checked.name: Tansman, Alexandre
composers_checked.note: Both IMSLP pages (Quartets Nos. 2 and 3) kept. Gap check against the Wikipedia work list and the Naxos, DUX and Etcetera discs added Quartets 4-8, Triptyque, the piano quintet Musica a cinque, Piano Trio No. 2, Suite-Divertissement, the three clarinet works and two works known only from the Wikipedia discography. The String Trio No. 2 and Sérénade No. 2 come from the DUX disc (years not found). Not added: Quartet No. 1 (1917, no recording), the Septuor and the Divertimento a Schönberg (no recording found), Tombeau de Chopin (string quintet or orchestra, scoring unclear).

composers_checked.name: Wellesz, Egon
composers_checked.note: 14 IMSLP pages: 10 kept, 4 skipped. Gap check against the Wikipedia work list added Quartet No. 3 and the String Trio Op. 86 (both recorded). Not added: the cantata The Leaden Echo and the Golden Echo (voice, clarinet, cello, piano; cantata) and the Geistliches Lied (voice, violin, viola, piano), the suites and sonatas for solo or duo. The input lists the Clarinet Quintet with opus Op. 91; the recording and the Wikipedia list give Op. 81.

composers_checked.name: Goldschmidt, Berthold
composers_checked.note: The IMSLP page (Quartet No. 1) is skipped for lack of a recording. Gap check against the Wikipedia work list found recordings only of the String Quartet No. 4 and the string trio Retrospectrum (Largo 5128, Mandelring Quartet and Gaede Trio) and of the oboe, cello and harp Fantasy. Not found recorded: Quartets 2 and 3, the Clarinet Quartet, the Piano Trio, Carols for string trio.

composers_checked.name: Castelnuovo-Tedesco, Mario
composers_checked.note: The one IMSLP page (Guitar Quintet) kept. Gap check against the Wikipedia work list added three quartets, two piano quintets, two piano trios, the string trio and the Concertino, each on a Naxos, Dynamic, Albany or Da Vinci disc. Also added the harp Concertino Op. 93 (Crystal Records, found through MusicBrainz). Not added: the Songs of the Shulamite Op. 163, the Quartet movement Op. 170/28; his duos and guitar-and-wind works have no string part or only two players.

composers_checked.name: Wolpe, Stefan
composers_checked.note: Both IMSLP pages kept. Gap check against the Wikipedia work list added the Oboe Quartet (Naxos and CPO). Not added: In Two Parts for Six Players (clarinet, trumpet, violin, cello, harp, piano), Quintet with Voice and the Piece for Trumpet and Seven Instruments (no recording found), Chamber Pieces Nos. 1 and 2 (14 players), and the quartet for trumpet, saxophone, percussion and piano (no strings).

composers_checked.name: Ben-Haim, Paul
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages (Ben-Haim died 1984). Five works with strings and a commercial recording, from the Wikipedia and de.wikipedia notes and the Chandos, Toccata and Centaur discs (the second viola of the quintet is inferred from the MusicWeb review of the Toccata disc). Not added: Two Landscapes Op. 27 and Canzonetta (scoring not confirmed), the duos and the wind quintet. Years left blank where no source gave them.

composers_checked.name: Rathaus, Karol
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages. Kept the quartets Nos. 3-5 (Acte Préalable AP069, titled complete) and the two piano trios (DUX). Quartets Nos. 1 and 2 are not on that disc and no other recording was found. The opus numbers of Nos. 4 and 5 follow the Acte Préalable disc (de.wikipedia has Op. 60 and Op. 71), hence confidence medium.

composers_checked.name: Zeisl, Eric
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages. The three works of the Wikipedia work list with strings (piano trio suite, second quartet, Arrowhead trio) are all on the harmonia mundi disc. The Brandeis Sonata and the cello sonata are duos; a first string quartet is not listed or recorded.

composers_checked.name: Schoeck, Othmar
composers_checked.note: Both IMSLP pages kept; gap check added Quartet No. 2 (recorded twice). Not added: the one-movement quartet fragment in B-flat (3 minutes), the violin and bass-clarinet sonatas (duos), the string-orchestra works. A piano quintet of about 1907 is mentioned in some lists but no recording or edition was found.

composers_checked.name: Martin, Frank
composers_checked.note: 7 IMSLP pages: 5 kept, 2 skipped (Etudes for string orchestra; Rhapsodie, no recording of the quintet version). Not added: Quatre sonnets à Cassandre (mezzo, flute, viola, cello; no recording of that version confirmed), the Sonata da chiesa and the Ballades (duos with organ or piano), the Passacaille.

composers_checked.name: Burkhard, Willy
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages. Only the Piano Trio Op. 43 has a commercial recording that Deezer, Apple Music or MusicBrainz show (VDE-GALLO). Not found recorded: String Trio Op. 13, String Quartets Nos. 1 (Op. 23) and 2 (Op. 68), Serenade Op. 77 for eight players, the cantatas with piano trio (vocal).

composers_checked.name: Honegger, Arthur
composers_checked.note: All 6 IMSLP pages kept. Gap check against the Wikipedia work list added the early piano trio H 6, the quartet variations H 74 and Colloque H 216, all on the Timpani set. Not added: the songs H 54 and H 63 (voice with flute and quartet, or piano), H 22, H 73, H 89 and H 147 (no recording found), the Hymne for ten strings (ten players), and the duo sonatas and sonatinas.

composers_checked.name: Milhaud, Darius
composers_checked.note: All 28 IMSLP pages judged: 27 works kept in all (the Op. 291 page gives Quartets 14, 15 and the Octet), 3 pages skipped. Quartets 1-18 are all on the Parisii cycle (Naïve) and Nos. 1-8 on Troubadisc. Gap check added Les rêves de Jacob, the Piano Quartet Op. 417, the Piano Trio Op. 428 (Largo 5112) and the two late quartet pieces Op. 435 and 442. Also added the Aspen Serenade Op. 361 (nine soloists; IMSLP page outside the input, listed there as chamber orchestra). The IRCAM Brahms list of the chamber works was used as a second gap check. Not found recorded: Quintets Nos. 1 (Op. 312, with piano) and 4 (Op. 350), the String Septet Op. 408, Adieu (voice, flute, viola, harp, 1964). Not added: Machines agricoles and Catalogue de fleurs (voice with chamber ensemble, scoring not confirmed), Stanford Serenade (twelve players), Symphonie de chambre No. 6 (voices, oboe, cello; no recording found), Nos. 4 and 5 (ten players).

note: EVIDENCE: Deezer album and track lists (labels, years, timings; album ids in sources) are the main recording evidence, with Apple Music lookups and composerTerm searches, MusicBrainz work lists with recording relations (Krenek Quartets 2, 4, 6 on MDG; Milhaud Piano Trio Op. 428; Castelnuovo harp Concertino), the 67 IMSLP candidate pages fetched through the API (publishers, first editions, scoring), Wikipedia work lists (en; de for Krenek and Ben-Haim), MusicWeb and classical-music.com reviews (Tansman Naxos disc, BR Klassik Frauentanz, Toccata Ben-Haim, Largo Goldschmidt) and Boosey & Hawkes catalogue pages found by search. Naxos Library and Presto were not used. Ben-Haim, Rathaus, Zeisl and Burkhard have no IMSLP pages: their lists come from Wikipedia and the discs. VIOLIN CATALOGUE: id 501 (Milhaud, Sonata for Two Violins and Piano, Op. 15) is cross-listed; 481 (Honegger) and 500, 502 (Milhaud) are duos for two violins and stay in the violin section. OWNER MAY RULE: (1) Five works with voice are kept under the vocal-chamber rule: Honegger Pâques à New York, Weill Frauentanz (soprano with five instruments), Wellesz Sonnets Op. 52 (Fleming and the Emerson Quartet), Schoeck Notturno, and Milhaud Quartet No. 3 (string quartet with a solo voice; formation string-quartet with a note). (2) Honegger Rapsodie H 13: IMSLP names 2 flutes, clarinet and piano first and the strings as the alternative; kept as the string version with alternatives, and the recording's version is not stated. (3) Ten IMSLP pages are skipped without any recording or documented performance: Milhaud Quintets 2 and 3 and the String Sextet (Heugel prints), Wellesz Quartets 1, 8, 9 and the Op. 109 quintet pieces, Goldschmidt Quartet 1, Martin Rhapsodie, plus Martin's Etudes (string orchestra); a documented performance would admit them. (4) Source conflicts: Rathaus Quartets 4 and 5 (Op. 59 and 72 on the discs, Op. 60 and 71 on de.wikipedia); Wellesz Clarinet Quintet (the input says Op. 91, recording and Wikipedia Op. 81); Wellesz Quartet No. 8 (Wikipedia says Artis recorded it, their disc holds Nos. 3, 4, 6); Krenek String Trio Op. 118 (1949 on de.wikipedia; en.wikipedia lists it as Op. 108, 1946); Tansman Triptyque (en.wikipedia: string orchestra; recorded for quartet three times); Milhaud Chamber Symphony No. 1 (piccolo and harp, as IMSLP lists it). (5) Medium confidence: Tansman Sextuor and Sonatina da camera (recording known only from the Wikipedia discography), Tansman String Trio No. 2 and Sérénade No. 2 (DUX disc, no year found), the Rathaus quartets (opus numbers), Weill Frauentanz, Burkhard Piano Trio, Goldschmidt Retrospectrum, Ben-Haim Variations and String Quintet, Milhaud Piano Trio Op. 428, Castelnuovo Concertino Op. 93, Krenek Alpbach scoring not used. NOT COVERED: Tansman's and Castelnuovo's catalogues are large and were checked against Wikipedia lists and the discs found, not the Eschig, Ricordi or Boosey catalogues; Milhaud's Machines agricoles and Catalogue de fleurs (voice with seven instruments) and Honegger's songs with flute and quartet were not added because the scoring was not confirmed; Burkhard's quartets, string trio and Serenade Op. 77 and Wolpe's other ensemble pieces have no recording that I could find.
